collections.description:
Boasting a minimalist profile, these wooden acoustic panels fit perfectly with most interior styles. They harmonize with all wall paint tones, bringing outstanding noise reduction and elegant texture to your room.

Flexible mounting: Panels can be installed horizontally or vertically to match your wall design.

collections.description:
• The shower panel can be placed on existing tiles or glued directly to the raw wall. The installation takes place without joints, which greatly facilitates the application.


    • Designed to protect the walls of the bathroom from any splashes of water but also from any infiltration of moisture


    • The panels useful to be used in renovations or for a new building, remaining a very economical choice because it reduces the processing for the realization of the cladding.


    • If you want to renovate the walls of the bathroom without going to carry out large works of masons, you can give a new look by placing the panels directly on the tiles.


    • It remains a hygienic choice, easy to maintain and clean, as it eliminates tile joints thus reducing spaces where bacteria can proliferate.
